data.title: Anthropic set to secure $1.8 trillion valuation in strong Nasdaq debut
data.description:
Nov 19 (Reuters) - Anthropic was on course to secure a $1.8 trillion valuation when its shares start trading on Thursday, in a historic debut that pits promises of AI as an economic game-changer against fears of a market bubble and risks to humanity.

The stock was set to open at $99.82, about 20% higher than the IPO price of $83, according to indications as of 9.50 am ET.

The Claude chatbot maker's upsized IPO, together with Tuesday's earnings report by AI poster child Nvidia ( NVDA ), signals the industry has nominally passed the two big tests facing it this week.

The strong demand for Anthropic shares amid a broader tech selloff offers hope to a sector where euphoria has somewhat cooled in recent weeks.

"I've looked at this whole week as a referendum on AI. Nvidia ( NVDA ) gave us a read on the buildout, and Anthropic is about to give us a read on investor appetite for the next generation of AI companies," Jake Behan, head of capital markets at Direxion, said before the Anthropic debut.

AI technology has boosted economic growth, sparked doomsday warnings and arguably helped usher in a data-center-skeptic Democratic tsunami in the US midterm elections.

Investors who once embraced the boom have turned skeptical in recent weeks over concerns that the enormous spending needed to build out the sector and the mounting debt loads may not be justified by the eventual returns.

AN INDUSTRY BENCHMARK

As the first frontier AI company to go public, Anthropic is poised to become the sector's benchmark, with its arch-rival OpenAI reportedly eyeing a 2027 listing.

The company sold 980 million shares at $83 each, pricing the IPO above its initial range of $70 to $78 set when it launched the road show. Its IPO proceeds could climb to as much as $93.5 billion if underwriters fully exercise their option to purchase additional shares.

Currently, the figure sits at over $107 billion, including the additional $26 billion raised through a private placement. AMD, Broadcom, Alphabet's Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia ( NVDA ) and TSMC were the investors in the private placement.

"Some of the demand may simply reflect investors not wanting to miss out on the rare opportunity to gain exposure to a leading AI company, even if its long-term profitability remains uncertain," IPOX associate Lukas Muehlbauer said.

London-based index rebalance analytics firm Intropic estimates passive demand from index-tracking funds will account for purchase of up to 30% of Anthropic's shares offered by the end of the year.

Anthropic will also join the trillion-dollar club stacked with behemoths such as Microsoft, Apple and Nvidia ( NVDA ).

The blockbuster deal is going to earn the underwriters, led by Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, a $550 million fee, a regulatory filing showed.

BIG PAYDAY FOR CO-FOUNDERS

Although shares can be volatile in the days following a listing, Anthropic's IPO is set to create thousands of paper millionaires and a handful of billionaires.

Based on the IPO price, CEO Dario Amodei and his six co-founders, who together own about 10% of the company, had stakes valued at nearly $150 billion, according to a Reuters calculation based on details in the filing.

More broadly, the listing is expected to create a wave of new wealth across the AI sector, rewarding everyone from early researchers and engineers to administrative staff.

JUSTIFYING THE PRICE TAG

Debate has intensified across global markets in recent months over whether the AI boom is veering into bubble territory, with economists, CEOs and political leaders split over its sustainability.

Much of the scrutiny has focused on circular financing arrangements. A complicated web of deals between AI companies, chipmakers, cloud providers and investors has raised questions over how much of the industry's growth is being fueled by money circulating within the same ecosystem.

Anthropic's breakneck growth has so far defied these concerns, but some investors have said they may wait for the initial euphoria to subside before buying.

"Anthropic is a one-trick pony. People compare it with Amazon because even Amazon lost money for several years, but Anthropic won't have that luxury," said Bill Gunderson, partner at GCG Advisory Partners.

"They've got to get to profitability soon."

Anthropic has nearly $900 billion in computing commitments with partners including Amazon and Alphabet's Google, underscoring how its rapid growth hinges on securing vast amounts of future computing capacity, some of which relies on financing beyond the company's control.

Investors will be watching Anthropic's debut and subsequent trading closely, with analysts expecting the stock to emerge as a proxy for the broader AI trade.

The company will also need to balance growth with calls to slow the development of advanced AI models. Anthropic warned in its IPO prospectus that AI could behave unpredictably and advance faster than oversight mechanisms.

(Reporting by Niket Nishant, Manya Saini in Bengaluru and Echo Wang in New York; Editing by Christian Plumb and Arun Koyyur)

DALLAS, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Transparency-One, ISN®’s responsible sourcing platform built to help bring transparency to supply chain management, announced new capabilities within its platform. New Supplier Scorecard, Mapping to Origin dashboard, and To-Do List summary, along with enhanced Data and Document Collection & Verification capabilities help streamline supplier performance tracking.

New enhancements include:

  • Supplier Scorecard: Consolidated view of supplier performance combining Transparency Score and risk analytics including sanctions list screening, social risk, and environmental risk.
  • Mapping to Origin: Visualization of supply chain traceability to the point of origin based on commodity criteria.
  • To-Do List: Redesigned homepage consolidating outstanding action items into a single prioritized list.
  • Document Review: Document reviews conducted by risk professionals to assess supplier submitted materials, including Certificates of Origin (COOs).

“From the Supplier Scorecard and Mapping to Origin visualization to a redesigned To-Do List and enhanced Document Review & Verification process, these updates help buyers obtain a clearer view of supplier performance and compliance,” said Brittany Sizemore, Senior Vice President at Transparency-One. “Transparency-One’s sustainability and risk experts help validate critical documents across multi-tier supply chains while providing suppliers with actionable guidance, which helps buyers gain confidence in their sourcing decisions.”

data.title: AleForge Launches Pay-as-You-Go Game Hosting
data.description:
Oakwood, GA, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- AleForge, a premier, high-performance game server provider, today announced the official launch of its new Pay-as-You-Go game hosting service. Designed for gamers who want total control over their hosting costs, the new billing model allows players to pay exclusively for the exact minutes their server is running, eliminating the wasted expenses associated with standard 24/7 monthly subscriptions.

Image: AleForge Launches Pay-as-You-Go Game Hosting

Only pay for the server time you actually use with AleForge's new per-minute billing.

Traditionally, weekend warriors and casual co-op groups have been forced to pay full monthly rates for servers that sit idle for most of the week. AleForge’s true Pay-as-You-Go model disrupts this standard. Users simply add a prepaid credit balance to their account and deploy a server. If a group plays for exactly 43 minutes, they are billed for exactly 43 minutes.

When players are done for the night, they can stop the server from the AleForge control panel or by creating a schedule to stop and start the server. Once stopped RAM and CPU billing halts that exact minute. Game worlds, mods, and progress remain perfectly intact, with only the disk space continuing to bill at fractions of a cent (approximately $0.20 per GB monthly) to safely store the files.

"A weekend server shouldn't cost the same as one that never sleeps," the company noted in its launch announcement.

The financial benefits for part-time server communities are substantial. A standard server configured with 4 GB of RAM, 2 vCPUs, and 20 GB of disk space running only on evenings and weekends (roughly 16 hours a week) costs approximately $6.00 per month under the new Pay-as-You-Go model. Compared to a traditional competitor's plan offering the same 4 GB / 2 vCPU specifications for 24/7 uptime at an estimated $11.99 per month, a part-time server owner can save 50% or more by utilizing AleForge's per-minute billing system.

Pay-as-You-Go users retain access to the full suite of AleForge’s premium features. Servers are deployed on high-performance NVMe SSDs with enterprise-grade DDoS protection, and users manage their worlds through AleForge’s custom Blacksmith control panel, which features one-click modpack installations. Customers also have the ultimate flexibility to dynamically slide their RAM, CPU, and disk limits up for massive weekend events, and scale them back down when the event concludes.

The service provides transparent hourly rates for precise resource tracking, which the billing system then divides by 60 to calculate the exact per-minute charge:

  • RAM: ~$0.0056 / GB-hour (billed only while running)
  • CPU: ~$0.0028 / vCPU-hour (billed only while running)
  • Disk: ~$0.0003 / GB-hour (billed continuously to save world data)
  • Databases & Backups: Billed only while actively in use

AleForge ensures players are never caught off guard by depleted funds. The system sends automated alerts when an account has 24 hours and 8 hours of credit remaining. If a balance hits $0, servers are granted a 2-hour grace period before safely suspending, giving users 7 days to top up their account and bring their world back online instantly.

Players can start building their custom Pay-as-You-Go server today with a minimum $5.00 account deposit by visiting AleForge's configurator.

Read the full announcement and pricing breakdown on the AleForge blog.

About AleForge

Based in Oakwood, Georgia, AleForge provides powerful, high-performance game server hosting for over 45 top titles, including Minecraft, Palworld, Valheim, and Terraria. Backed by 24/7 expert support and premium hardware, AleForge empowers gaming communities of all sizes to build, explore, and play on their own terms.

data.title: Canada Commodities: Oil Prices Rise as Tanker Attacks in Strait of Hormuz Heighten Supply Concerns
data.description:
10:00 AM EST, 11/19/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Crude oil prices were higher mid-morning Thursday as fighting in the Middle East continued, along with reports of several oil tankers being set ablaze.

Several media outlets said that Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corp (IRGC) Navy said two supertankers, escorted by US jets, hit mines in the Strait of Hormuz and are on fire. Three other tankers are on fire after hitting mines east of the strait, the reports said.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) also said on Wednesday that two oil tankers were struck by unknown projectiles off the coast of Oman.

West Texas Intermediate December crude oil futures, the US benchmark, rose 1.8% to $84.75 per barrel. January Brent oil futures, the international benchmark, climbed 1.5% to $93.39 a barrel.

Comex gold December futures dropped 0.9% to $3,708.90 per ounce, still at the lowest level since mid-September 2025.

In agricultural commodities, March wheat futures rose 2% to $5.97 per bushel, while canola futures for January climbed 1.3% to CA$781.20 per tonne.

data.title: Halozyme Therapeutics Says German Court Lifted Injunction on Merck's Keytruda SC
data.description:
10:13 AM EST, 11/19/2026 (MT Newswires) -- Halozyme Therapeutics ( HALO ) said Thursday a German appeals court lifted a preliminary injunction that barred Merck ( MRK ) from offering or distributing Keytruda SC in Germany.

The company will immediately sue Merck ( MRK ) for patent infringement in Germany and seek a permanent injunction, Chief Legal Officer Mark Snyder said.

In October, a Dutch patent court barred the holder of Merck's ( MRK ) European marketing authorization from making, selling or importing the drug in eight European countries, Halozyme said.

Halozyme said the MDASE patent dispute will have no effect on licensees' use of its ENHANZE technology or the revenue it earns from those licenses.

Shares of the company were down over 3% in Thursday trading.

data.title: Fast Simon Unveils New MCP Server, Slashing Time-to-Market For E-commerce Agencies And Developers
data.description:
• The new MCP server reduces effort and implementation time for developers and agencies that support e-commerce retailers.
  • Brands using headless architecture can now deploy Fast Simon in hours, not weeks.
  • The new server enables more retailers to deploy smarter storefronts quicker than ever and with less friction.

LOS ALTOS, Calif., Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Fast Simon, a unified AI product discovery platform driving higher conversion and revenue through merchandising, personalization, and search, today unveiled a new Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. The new MCP server works with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf and Cline.

Fast Simon has always delivered the fastest time to market for mid- and enterprise-sized retailers with its no-code, server-side rendering solution. Now, the company has made implementation easier for an even larger group of users, including e-commerce agencies and developers who implement their own storefront using an SDK.

Effective immediately, even retailers with few IT resources, or developers with headless architecture, can implement a Fast Simon experience in hours, not weeks. This represents a major moment for the industry, enabling more brands to launch an intelligent storefront faster and with fewer hurdles.

“Developers, agencies, and even brands with few technical resources can now design and deploy a fully functional Fast Simon experience faster than ever before,” said Zohar Gilad, co-founder and CEO of Fast Simon. “Our MCP server helps developers build with the SDK and empowers merchandisers to read and act on their own analytics.”

Fast Simon’s implementation knowledge is available directly inside the coding workflow. That means with the merchant's API key it can answer questions about their analytics, such as top searches, top collections, and widget impact in plain language. This makes Fast Simon’s ecommerce expertise easily accessible to a wide range of technical and non-technical users.

Just as Fast Simon powers conversational commerce for shoppers, the MCP server powers conversational coding. “Integrating Fast Simon into our storefront with the SDK took virtually no effort,” said Rudy Falco, Director of Digital Commerce and Marketing at CMC Motorsports. “Using the MCP server with Claude, there was no special trick or heavy coding. I just asked it to build what we needed in natural language, and it was done that day.”

Fast Simon has recently released several new features and enhanced capabilities that streamline workflow and boost revenue for retail brands, including Commerce-Native AI and Cross Border Merchandising.

About Fast Simon

Fast Simon powers e-commerce intelligence for some of the world’s fastest-growing and most recognized brands on Shopify. Their unified AI product discovery platform empowers thousands of mid-market and enterprise retailers to increase revenue and reduce manual merchandising efforts at scale. Through a purpose-built platform, Fast Simon delivers the best overall shopping experience with optimized merchandising, personalization, search, and shopping agents that increase conversion and revenue.

data.title: AT&T and U.S. Soccer Extend Longstanding Relationship to Continue Shaping the Future of Soccer in America
data.description:
AT&T ( T ) will continue supporting U.S. Soccer and its National Teams by investing in the athletes, programs and platforms that help grow the game

DALLAS, Nov. 19, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- 

At-a-glance

  • AT&T ( T ) and U.S. Soccer are renewing their multiyear sponsorship agreement, continuing a relationship that began in 2009.
  • The sponsorship supports U.S. Soccer and its National Teams while creating more opportunities for fans to engage with its teams and athletes.
  • The renewal continues AT&T's ( T ) investment in the athletes, programs and fan experiences helping grow soccer in the United States.
  • The agreement spans U.S. Soccer's National Teams, fan programming and AT&T's ( T ) support as a Founding Partner of the Arthur M. Blank U.S. Soccer National Training Center.
  • AT&T ( T ) will continue supporting U.S. Soccer through athlete storytelling, fan engagement and long-term investment in the sport, including initiatives that elevate women athletes through She's Connected by AT&T ( T ), a branded content series that showcases athlete stories and the role of connectivity in their careers.

As soccer continues to grow across America, AT&T ( T ) and U.S. Soccer are extending their longstanding partnership, which began in 2009. Through the multiyear renewal, AT&T ( T ) will continue championing U.S. Soccer and its National Teams through athlete storytelling, fan engagement and long-term investment in the sport.

Why it matters

The renewal comes as soccer continues to gain momentum across the U.S. As more people play, watch and follow the sport across the country, AT&T ( T ) and U.S. Soccer will continue creating new ways for fans to connect with the teams, athletes and moments that make soccer meaningful.

What's new

AT&T's ( T ) support of U.S. Soccer also extends to the Arthur M. Blank U.S. Soccer National Training Center, the new home for all 27 U.S. Soccer National Teams. The facility will bring the Men's and Women's National Teams together at one training location for the first time. As a Founding Partner, AT&T ( T ) will provide advanced connectivity across the campus, including AT&T Connected Fields, to support how players and coaches prepare, analyze performance and improve their game. Looking ahead, AT&T ( T ) and U.S. Soccer will explore new ways to connect players with technology and data that can enhance training and performance.

The renewal also gives fans more ways to engage with U.S. Soccer's teams and athletes through content, matchday activations and other programming. Through She's Connected by AT&T ( T ), the company will continue putting women athletes in the spotlight, telling their stories and showcasing their impact well beyond the field.

What our experts are saying

"We've been proud to support U.S. Soccer since 2009, and we believe the sport's greatest opportunities are still ahead," said Sabina Ahmed, assistant vice president of media and sponsorships, AT&T ( T ). "As soccer continues to grow, so does its ability to inspire, unite and open doors for people on and off the field. Through this partnership, we're helping more fans connect with the sport they love while supporting the athletes, programs and facilities moving the game forward."

"Soccer is reaching more people across the country, and partners like AT&T ( T ) help us turn that interest into lasting fandom," said David Wright, Chief Business Officer at U.S. Soccer. "AT&T ( T ) has been part of U.S. Soccer since 2009, and as a Founding Partner of the Arthur M. Blank U.S. Soccer National Training Center, it is helping create a home for all 27 of our National Teams. We're proud to continue working together to support our athletes, give fans more ways to engage with our teams and grow the game for the next generation."

"It's an exciting time for U.S. Soccer, and it means a lot to see AT&T ( T ) continue investing in the sport and our National Teams," said Christian Pulisic, U.S. Men's National Team player. "The new National Training Center is a great example of what that commitment can enable, bringing our teams together in one place with the connectivity and technology to help us prepare and perform at our best."

The big picture

After more than 15 years together, AT&T ( T ) and U.S. Soccer remain committed to supporting the athletes, fans and programs shaping what comes next for the sport.

Frequently asked questions

How long has AT&T ( T ) supported U.S. Soccer?
AT&T ( T ) has supported U.S. Soccer since 2009, including the U.S. Women's National Team, U.S. Men's National Team and the broader organization. The multiyear renewal continues that longstanding relationship.

What does AT&T's ( T ) renewed sponsorship with U.S. Soccer include?
AT&T's ( T ) renewed multiyear agreement includes continued support for U.S. Soccer and its National Teams, with a focus on athlete storytelling, fan engagement and long-term investment in the sport.

How will AT&T ( T ) and U.S. Soccer create more opportunities for fans to engage with the sport?
AT&T ( T ) and U.S. Soccer will create more opportunities for fans to engage with the National Teams and athletes through content, matchday activations and fan experiences.

What is AT&T's ( T ) role at the Arthur M. Blank U.S. Soccer National Training Center?
AT&T ( T ) is a Founding Partner of the Arthur M. Blank U.S. Soccer National Training Center, the new home for all 27 U.S. Soccer National Teams. AT&T ( T ) will provide advanced connectivity and technology across the campus to support training, collaboration and development.

How does AT&T ( T ) support women's soccer?
AT&T ( T ) supports women's soccer through its longstanding support of the U.S. Women's National Team, its sponsorship of the NWSL and its work with women athletes. Through She's Connected by AT&T ( T ), the company also helps elevate women athletes and share their stories on and off the field.

Does AT&T ( T ) support the U.S. Women's and Men's National Teams?
Yes. AT&T's ( T ) sponsorship of U.S. Soccer includes continued support for the U.S. Women's National Team, U.S. Men's National Team and U.S. Soccer's broader National Team program.

data.title: Italian court delays ruling in Meta, TikTok social media case pending government curbs
data.description:
* Milan court postpones decision until January 21

* Judges waiting for government's plan to bar under-13s from social media

* Parents' group wants stronger age checks on Facebook, Instagram and TikTok

By Sara Rossi

MILAN, Nov 19 (Reuters) - A Milan court on Thursday put off until January 21 its decision in a case brought by a group of Italian families seeking to restrict minors' access to Meta and TikTok, as the government prepares its own curbs.

Judges had been expected to rule on Thursday but postponed the hearing until January 21, lawyers involved in the case said, after the Italian government said on Wednesday it expected parliament to approve a decree restricting minors' access to social media by the end of the year. The hearing was held behind closed doors.

The class injunctive action, a collective lawsuit filed by MOIGE, an Italian parents' association, asks the court to require the companies, which operate Facebook, Instagram and TikTok, to adopt stronger age-verification systems for users under 14.

It also seeks measures to remove potentially manipulative algorithms and require the platforms to provide more transparent information about the possible harms associated with excessive social media use.

Lawyers for MOIGE said the court linked the postponement to the government's plans and that judges wanted to wait for them before ruling.

The plans include an amendment to a security decree, proposed earlier this week by Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni's ruling coalition, that would bar children under 13 from holding social media accounts.

MOIGE lawyer Stefano Bertone said the association had asked the judges on Thursday for an immediate order imposing stronger age checks and its other demands on the companies, rather than waiting for the government's measures.

"We made it very clear that an injunction was needed today, given the urgency of the situation and the cases linked to pathological social media addiction that occur every day and every week," he said.

MOIGE has said it wants to protect some 3.5 million Italian children aged between 7 and 14 who it says are illegally active on social media platforms.

At the first hearing in May, lawyers for Meta and TikTok raised preliminary objections, challenging the jurisdiction of Italian courts over their conduct.

Meta has rejected MOIGE's allegations, saying it has introduced measures including Teen Accounts and other safeguards aimed at protecting younger users.

TikTok has said it rigorously applies its Community Guidelines, including those aimed at protecting mental and behavioural health, and proactively removes more than 99% of content that violates them.

Social media companies are under pressure to modify their algorithms amid growing concerns worldwide that their platforms are contributing ​to a mental health crisis among children.

(Reporting by Sara Rossi in Milan and Giselda Vagnoni in Rome; Editing by Xevi Fontdegloria)

data.title: Fed's Jefferson says AI boosting inflation, productivity impact possible 'in the future'
data.description:
WASHINGTON, Nov 19 (Reuters) - The rapid artificial intelligence buildout is putting upward pressure on US inflation through its impact on demand, Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson said on Thursday, with possible productivity gains that could help ease price pressures only coming "in the future."

In prepared remarks to a Brazilian central bank conference, Jefferson said the AI boom is the sort of shock that could influence both demand and supply, but at different points in time.

"On the demand side, optimism about the technology has been boosting business investment in data centers, advanced computing equipment, and related products," Jefferson said. "Currently, the AI buildout is exerting upward pressure on demand and inflation."

Productivity improvements from the new technology could put downward pressure on prices, but only "in the future," Jefferson said, without estimating a timeline.

Jefferson's prepared remarks did not mention his current interest-rate outlook. The Fed is expected to raise its policy rate by a quarter of a percentage point from the current range of 3.75%-4.00% at its December 8-9 policy meeting.

(Reporting by Howard Schneider; Editing by Paul Simao)

data.title: Aratas Introduces Compact Relay to Expand Options for Industrial Applications
data.description:
New G3VM-61KR MOSFET relay combines high-current capability and fast switching in compact design, providing engineers greater flexibility

HOFFMAN ESTATES, Ill.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Today, Aratas America LLC, formerly OMRON Electronic Components, the trusted innovative technology solutions provider, announced the launch of its G3VM-61KR relay. The compact SOP 4-pin MOSFET relay is designed for industrial applications requiring high-current capability, fast switching and space-saving PCB layouts.

The G3VM-61KR is designed to help engineers develop more compact equipment while supporting applications that have traditionally relied on electromechanical relays. Its smaller package, high-current capacity and fast switching performance make it well suited for factory automation (FA) control equipment, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), measuring instruments and security systems.

Key features and benefits of the G3VM-61KR include:

  • Compact SOP 4-pin packaging: Reduces mounting area by 30% compared to a conventional SOP package, helping engineers reduce PCB space and support more compact equipment.
  • High-current capability and low on-resistance: Supports a maximum load current of 1A and maximum on-resistance of 0.3Ω, expanding the range of applications where MOSFET relays can replace electromechanical relays. Its low on-resistance also helps limit heat generation.
  • High-speed operation: Offers a maximum turn-on time (tON) of 0.5 ms and maximum turn-off time (tOFF) of 0.2 ms, supporting faster measuring devices and improved control response compared to existing models.

“Our goal is to provide customers with reliable, thoughtfully designed components that help address real-world engineering challenges,” said Evelyn Martinez, product manager at Aratas. “The G3VM-61KR reflects our continued focus on expanding our portfolio with solutions that give engineers more options as industrial applications and equipment requirements continue to evolve.”

For more information about Aratas and its electronic components portfolio, visit https://www.aratas.com/us-en/.

data.title: Ascentry Announces a New Choice for Laboratory Instrument Connectivity
data.description:
Ascentry Expands Access to Modern Laboratory Instrument Connectivity for Health Systems using Epic Beaker®

NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Ascentry today announced expanded access to Lab Composer, its modern, vendor-neutral laboratory middleware platform, for organizations using Epic Beaker®, giving health systems a new choice for laboratory instrument connectivity.

Laboratories are under increasing pressure to support more instruments, sites and workflows while managing staffing constraints and limited IT resources. As health systems grow, they need laboratory connectivity that simplifies operations, supports standardization and adapts to evolving needs.

We are pleased to introduce Lab Composer as a new choice for laboratory instrument connectivity for organizations using Epic Beaker®

Lab Composer is Ascentry's modern, vendor-neutral laboratory middleware platform, providing a specialized layer between laboratory instruments and the laboratory information system (LIS) to connect instruments and manage laboratory data flows.

Connectivity built for the laboratory

Laboratory connectivity goes beyond exchanging data between an instrument and a LIS. Laboratories operate across multiple disciplines, instrument vendors and locations, each with specific workflows and operational requirements.

Lab Composer provides a common connectivity platform that complements the LIS while addressing the specific needs of the laboratory.

Key benefits include:

  • Vendor-neutral instrument connectivity, giving laboratories flexibility to select instrumentation based on their clinical and operational requirements.
  • Multi-site scalability, from physician office laboratories, critical access hospital laboratories, community hospitals, to integrated delivery networks, centralized core laboratories, reference laboratories, and state health system laboratory networks.
  • Complete traceability and visibility across instrument communications, data flows and laboratory workflows.
  • Modern, web-based architecture designed for performance, cybersecurity and scalability.
  • Business continuity, including downtime recovery, real-time replication and LIS backup.
  • Modern rules engine supporting smart validation and configurable laboratory workflows.
  • Configurable dashboards providing role-based views, real-time alerts and operational visibility.
  • Support for every discipline, from hematology and electrophoresis to immunohematology and microplate techniques, with tailored views, bulk actions, and full traceability.

Lab Composer can also extend beyond connectivity with laboratory-focused capabilities such as quality control (QC) management, patient moving averages and task scheduling, designed to complement existing Beaker® workflows.

Looking ahead, Ascentry’s vision extends beyond the central core laboratory to include point-of-care testing connectivity across physician offices, hospitals and health systems, all on a single platform for managing in-laboratory instruments and testing performed outside the laboratory environment by nurses, medical assistants and other members of the care team.

Supporting distributed laboratory networks

For physician office labs, critical access hospitals and community and rural hospitals, laboratory instrument connectivity is particularly challenging due to limited IT resources, staffing pressures and multi-vendor environments. Modern laboratories must manage inpatient, outpatient, ambulatory care, outreach as a profit center, point-of-care testing, home testing, and direct-access testing.

Lab Composer helps health systems standardize connectivity across all testing locations, reduce local complexity and scale their infrastructure as their network evolves.

A particularly important opportunity for community and rural healthcare

Choice matters everywhere, but it may matter most where resources are most constrained.

Community and rural hospitals need access to the same kind of modern laboratory infrastructure as larger health systems but often cannot support the same level of local IT complexity or duplicated resources. Ascentry's strategy specifically addresses distributed healthcare models in which shared infrastructure and standardized operating models can support affiliated, community and rural sites.

Organizations participating in Community Connect®, as well as organizations using the Epic Orchard™ model, can evaluate Lab Composer for their instrument connectivity.

Laboratory expertise behind the technology

Ascentry brings more than 40 years of experience in laboratory software, with technology serving more than 4,500 laboratories worldwide.

Our teams support customers through change management, during implementation, through go-live and ongoing operations, combining instrument connectivity expertise with experience in Beaker® LIS environments.

“Expanding access to Lab Composer for organizations using Beaker is an important milestone for Ascentry. It gives laboratories greater flexibility in how they connect instruments and build a connectivity strategy that supports their needs today and in the future,” said Ludovic d’Aprea, President & CEO, Ascentry.

About Ascentry

Ascentry is a global provider of laboratory informatics solutions, enabling clinical laboratories, health systems, and IVD vendors to operate with clarity, speed and confidence. The company’s solutions are used in more than 4,500 laboratories across multiple countries, helping to ensure the right results for every patient, every time. Ascentry’s expertise spans clinical laboratory data management, instrument connectivity, middleware, point of care testing, and the prevention of healthcare associated infections, delivering scalable, high-performance solutions that address today’s most complex challenges.

Learn more at www.ascentry.com

data.title: Foundation Healthcare Holdings Builds on Growth Momentum with Two Strategic Acquisitions in Anaesthesiology and Dermatology
data.description:
• Acquisition of The Skin Specialists and Laser Clinic marks FHH’s entry into dermatology as its 17th specialty, expanding its specialist capabilities and referral pathways
  • Acquisition of Anaesthesia Connect strengthens the Group’s anaesthesia capabilities to support growing surgical volumes and its target of 20 anaesthesiologists by end-2026
  • Both acquisitions are expected to be immediately earnings- and EPS-accretive upon completion, contributing to the Group’s continued revenue growth and long-term shareholder value creation 

SINGAPORE--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Foundation Healthcare Holdings (“FHH”, and together with its subsidiaries, the “Group”), Singapore’s largest private multi-specialty healthcare group, announced that it has entered into two separate agreements to acquire Anaesthesia Connect Pte. Ltd. (“Anaesthesia Connect”) and The Skin Specialists and Laser Clinic Pte. Ltd. (“The Skin Specialists and Laser Clinic”, together with Anaesthesia Connect, the “Targets”), marking a strategic expansion of its platform (“Proposed Transactions”).

The Proposed Transactions comprise an initial acquisition of shares representing 60 per cent of the shares in the capital of the Targets and a subsequent acquisition of shares representing the remaining 40 per cent of the shares in the capital of the Targets.

With the Proposed Transactions, FHH will grow its platform to 120 specialists across 17 specialty groups, broadening its clinical capabilities in anaesthesia, a critical component of FHH’s specialist-led healthcare platform, while adding new capabilities in dermatology which will enable the Group to serve a wider range of patient needs. The Proposed Transactions complement the Group’s existing specialist network and ambulatory surgical infrastructure, creating opportunities to enhance care coordination, strengthen referral pathways and drive further growth.

Strengthening core capabilities to support surgical growth

FHH’s proposed acquisition of Anaesthesia Connect, led by Dr Tan Jyh Shen, will strengthen the Group’s anaesthesia capabilities, supporting a wide range of surgical procedures including those at its ambulatory surgical centres, while contributing to its target of growing its anaesthesiology network to 20 specialists by the end of 2026.

Dr Tan’s subspecialty expertise in orthopaedic anaesthesia and regional anaesthesia, together with his existing clinical relationships with several of the Group’s 20 orthopaedic and hand surgeons are expected to strengthen the delivery of coordinated surgical care across FHH’s musculoskeletal service line.

Beyond the clinical synergies, anaesthesiology represents an attractive asset-light business model. Unlike traditional specialist practices, anaesthesiology practices generally do not require dedicated clinic premises or extensive administrative and support staff. The resulting lean operating structure is expected to contribute positively to the Group’s overall margin profile as FHH continues to scale its specialist network.

Expanding into new specialty areas to drive integrated, coordinated care

FHH’s proposed acquisition of The Skin Specialists and Laser Clinic, led by Dr Mark Tang and Dr Colin Theng, marks the Group’s entry into dermatology, further diversifying its specialty offerings and expanding access to dermatological care within its network. The established practice provides medical and surgical dermatology services, including the management of eczema, psoriasis, acne and skin cancers, alongside skin cancer screening, minor surgical procedures and laser treatments.

The addition of dermatology will also strengthen care coordination across FHH’s existing network. Patients referred through FHH’s Health Connective programme (“HCP”) who require dermatological consultations or treatment will now be able to access these services within FHH, rather than being referred to external providers. FHH’s HCP connects general practitioners and specialists to facilitate referrals and streamline care coordination between providers to help simplify patients’ healthcare journeys.

Suitable dermatological surgical procedures may also be performed at Foundation Ambulatory Centre Orchard and Foundation Ambulatory Centre Novena, creating opportunities to leverage its existing infrastructure and support the delivery of high-quality, cost-effective care in appropriate outpatient settings. The expansion into dermatology further diversifies the Group’s revenue base, while creating opportunities for cross-specialty collaboration and enabling the Group to capture a greater share of patient referrals within its network.

Terms of the Proposed Transactions

The two acquisitions have been structured to align the consideration payable with the financial performance of the respective practices, with the second tranche consideration payable tied to the Targets’ respective profits up to a cap, reflecting FHH’s disciplined approach to acquisitions and capital deployment.

Under the terms of the respective Proposed Transactions

  • FHH will acquire 60 per cent of the shares in the capital of Anaesthesia Connect, for an initial consideration of approximately S$4.3 million, payable in cash on first completion.
  • FHH will acquire 60 per cent of the shares in the capital of The Skin Specialists and Laser Clinic, for an initial consideration of approximately S$12.9 million, payable in cash on first completion.

In both Proposed Transactions, the remaining 40 per cent of shares of capital of the respective Targets will be acquired subsequently, with the consideration to be determined based on the Target’s financial performance in the future and payable through a combination of cash and newly issued FHH shares, subject to the terms of the agreement.

The completion of the first tranche is expected to take place at the end of 2026 and the completion of the second tranche is expected to take place at the end of 2029.

Adjusted and Unadjusted Management Accounts

References to Adjusted and Unadjusted figures are based on the respective Targets’ FY25 management accounts1. Adjusted figures reflect the transition of the Targets’ medical specialist remuneration arrangements to the Group’s remuneration framework, which will take effect from date of Completion.

The financial information based on the Adjusted Target Management Accounts FY25 is provided solely to assist in understanding the basis on which the Company has evaluated the Proposed Transactions, and to illustrate the financial effects of the Proposed Transactions. It should not be construed as a forecast or projection of the Group’s future financial performance.

Historical financial performance

On an Unadjusted basis and for the financial year ended 31 December 2025 (“FY2025”):

  • Anaesthesia Connect recorded a net profit of approximately S$1.8 million.
  • The Skin Specialists and Laser Clinic recorded a net profit of approximately S$3.1 million.

Financial impact of the Proposed Transactions

To provide shareholders with a more representative illustration of the combined impact of both acquisitions, assuming the second tranche is completed in cash, on the Group’s earnings per share (“EPS”), the Company has presented adjusted EPS calculations incorporating the revised remuneration arrangements and unadjusted figures for completion:

  • The proposed acquisition of Anaesthesia Connect would have increased the Group’s Adjusted FY2025 EPS from 1.06 Singapore cents to 1.10 Singapore cents following first tranche completion, and to 1.14 Singapore cents following second tranche completion. On an Unadjusted basis, the corresponding EPS would have been 1.14 Singapore cents and 1.19 Singapore cents, respectively.
  • The proposed acquisition of The Skin Specialists and Laser Clinic would have increased the Group’s Adjusted FY2025 EPS from 1.06 Singapore cents to 1.16 Singapore cents following first tranche completion, and to 1.23 Singapore cents following second tranche completion. On an Unadjusted basis, the corresponding EPS would have been 1.19 Singapore cents and 1.29 Singapore cents, respectively.
  • On an Adjusted and Unadjusted basis, the Proposed Transactions are expected to be EPS accretive for the Group.

Mr Liaw Yit Ming, Co-Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Foundation Healthcare Holdings, said: “These acquisitions reflect our disciplined approach to expanding our specialist network, focusing on areas where we see strong patient demand and opportunities to build on our existing capabilities. These two acquisitions demonstrate our ability to continue to execute on our growth strategy and attract established practices even amid current market conditions, enabling us to broaden the range of care available to patients while strengthening collaboration across our network.

“Both acquisitions reflect our disciplined approach to growth, as we continue to expand in specialty areas that complement our existing businesses and unlock operational synergies. Throughout 2026, we continued to invest ahead of growth while sustaining strong revenue momentum. Importantly, both acquisitions are expected to contribute positively to our earnings from completion, supporting our focus on profitable growth while building a more diversified healthcare platform that delivers long-term value for shareholders.”

Outlook

FHH continues to see strong growth opportunities as it expands its specialist network through both organic recruitment and strategic acquisitions. Revenue continues to grow at a mid-to-high teens rate, in line with the growth trajectory previously communicated in the Group’s FY2025 results. The Group anticipates an adjusted EBITDA margin marginally below 1H2026 levels in 2H2026 as the higher proportion of newly recruited specialists has contributed to some near-term margin pressure as their practices ramp up. Looking ahead, FHH expects profitability to improve progressively as these practices mature and patient volumes grow.

About Foundation Healthcare Holdings

Foundation Healthcare Holdings (FHH) is Singapore’s largest private multi-specialty healthcare group, dedicated to transforming and strengthening the healthcare ecosystem through collaboration, innovation, and patient-centred care. Through strategic partnerships and technology-enabled care coordination, FHH makes private healthcare more sustainable, accessible, and affordable by eliminating operational inefficiencies. FHH’s growing ecosystem encompasses more than 115 in-house specialists across 17 specialties, alongside a portfolio of ambulatory surgery centres and ancillary services.

For more information, visit Foundation Healthcare at www.foundationhealthcare.sg, or follow Foundation Healthcare on LinkedIn.

About FHH’s Health Connective Programme

The Health Connective Programme (“HCP”) is an initiative by Foundation Healthcare Holdings established to connect a network of more than 500 general practitioners across Singapore with multidisciplinary network of medical specialists, allied health providers, diagnostic services and ambulatory care facilities.

Supported by a dedicated Patient Assistance Centre (“PAC”) and a proprietary digital healthcare platform, AVA™, HCP streamlines care coordination between providers to help simplify patients’ healthcare journeys. Through collaboration with healthcare providers and insurers, HCP seeks to improve access to care while promoting greater convenience and efficiency across the private healthcare ecosystem.

data.title: ONAR Issues Letter to Stockholders: Pro Forma Nine-Month Revenue of $13.5 Million With Advertise Purple, More Than Four Times the $3.1 Million Reported
data.description:
Miami, FL, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ONAR Holding Corporation ( ONAR ) (“ONAR” or the “Company”), an AI-powered marketing platform, today filed its Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and issued the following letter to stockholders from Chief Executive Officer Claude Zdanow.

Dear Fellow Stockholders,

In July, I gave you four priorities and said we would report on each one as it moved from plan to fact. Four months later, three of them are fact: the acquisition, the financing that paid for it, and the exchange of certain of our lenders’ older debt into the same convertible notes issued in the financing. The fourth, a listing of our common stock on a national securities exchange (a “listing”), is where the work is now.

The short version:

  • What we bought. Advertise Purple LLC (“Advertise Purple”), a leader in affiliate and partnership marketing and a business more than three times our size by revenue.
  • How to read the report we filed today. We owned Advertise Purple for two days of the quarter. On a pro forma basis for the full nine months, revenue would have been $13.5 million, not the $3.1 million we reported.
  • The cash. A nine-month net loss of $3.61 million, but only $0.59 million of cash used in operations.
  • What the company was valued at. $25 million pre-money and before any debt converts, which implies about $36 million to $40 million for the combined company once the debt converts. One fixed price, $0.038576 per share. Holders of our existing preferred stock intend to exchange into the same class.
  • The debt. Total liabilities of $37.7 million. About $15 million can potentially become equity on a listing: $11.0 million would convert to preferred stock automatically, and $3.9 million of senior convertible notes can convert at the holders’ election. Approximately $16.4 million is the purchase price for Advertise Purple that we agreed to pay over time. The cash paid at closing was funded largely with the September notes, short-term funding that we intend to convert to equity or refinance.
  • The companies are already working together. JUICE and Advertise Purple are cross-selling and driving new business for each other.
  • What comes next. A Nasdaq listing, which is not assured, and the 1-for-250 reverse stock split approved for it.

What we bought

On September 29 we acquired Advertise Purple, a business more than three times our size by revenue. Advertise Purple is a leader in affiliate and partnership marketing, one of the fastest-growing channels in digital marketing and one in which clients pay primarily for measured outcomes. It manages performance-based programs for a roster of established, well-recognized brands. It fits what ONAR ( ONAR ) is: an AI-powered marketing platform that acquires specialist marketing companies and runs them on shared technology, so that growth-stage and middle-market brands sell more of their products and services online. Together, our operating companies now serve approximately 400 clients. Cortex, our attribution platform, began billing subscription clients in July and has completed its first full quarter of recurring billings. That revenue is not yet material, but it is the first recurring technology revenue ONAR Labs has generated. With Advertise Purple we also acquired Bloom, its affiliate performance data platform.

How to read the report we filed today

Our third quarter report includes two days of Advertise Purple results and all of the debt from buying it. Note 2 of the Form 10-Q shows what revenue and net income would have been if we had owned Advertise Purple since January 1, 2025.

 Three months ended September 30, 2026Nine months ended September 30, 2026
Revenue, as reported$1.06 million$3.13 million
Pro Forma Revenue, as if we had owned Advertise Purple since January 1, 2025$4.44 million$13.52 million
Net loss, as reported$(1.36) million$(3.61) million
Pro Forma Net loss, as if we had owned Advertise Purple since January 1, 2025$(0.61) million$(1.25) million

Source: Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, condensed consolidated statements of operations and Note 2. The figures above, including Pro Forma amounts, are unaudited.

With Advertise Purple for the full period, pro forma nine-month revenue would have been $13.5 million, more than four times the $3.1 million we reported. Those figures combine two companies for a period before we owned one of them, and they are not a forecast. They do not include the interest on the acquisition debt, and they do not include any cost savings or synergies from combining the two companies. ONAR ( ONAR ) without the acquisition of Advertise Purple was already improving results: reported revenue grew 68% for the nine months, general and administrative expense fell 55%, and the loss from operations narrowed by 60%.

The cash

The cash picture is much better than the reported loss. For the nine months we reported a net loss of $3.61 million, but the business used only $0.59 million of cash in operations. Nearly three quarters of the loss was interest expense, and most of that interest was not paid in cash.

What the company was valued at

The investors in our September 28, 2026 financings, which funded the Advertise Purple acquisition, priced ONAR ( ONAR ) at $25 million pre-money and before any debt converts. Upon a listing, their convertible notes and the convertible notes our lenders exchanged older debt into become one class of preferred stock, Series 1. The Series 1 Preferred Stock converts into common stock at one fixed price, $0.038576 per share, which does not move with the market. On those terms, the equity after a listing would be valued at about $36 million once those notes convert, and about $40 million if the senior notes, which can convert on the same terms, convert as well. The $25 million is the value before any of that debt becomes equity. The to is the implied value of the combined company, including Advertise Purple, after the conversion of debt. The holders of our existing Series B, C and E preferred stock, including holders who also invested in the September 28 financings, intend to exchange into Series 1 Preferred Stock at the time of the listing, and the financing documents anticipate that exchange. However, definitive agreements regarding the preferred exchange are not yet signed and so it is not assured.

The $25 million valuation and the conversion terms are what the investors in the September 28 financings agreed to in their purchase agreements. That valuation is not the market value of our stock or a prediction of it, and conversion means more shares outstanding. The Form 10-Q has the detail, including the warrants issued with the financing.

The debt

Total liabilities are $37.7 million, up from $9.7 million at the start of the year. The table shows the three largest pieces, with the notes at face value. The rest includes accounts payable and accrued expenses of about , deferred revenue, warrant liabilities, and older notes and settlements on fixed payment schedules.

What it isAmountWhat happens to it
Senior convertible notes$3.9 millionDue September 2027. We are actively engaged with multiple lenders, through a placement agent, on a senior credit facility to refinance them, though a refinancing is not assured. Senior noteholders are also able to elect to convert into Series 1 preferred stock upon a listing.
Convertible notes that become equity on a listing$11.0 millionDue March 2028. Convert automatically into Series 1 preferred stock upon a listing. No cash repayment, after the conversion into preferred stock. $7.1 million of this is older debt our lenders exchanged, not new borrowing.
Purchase price for Advertise Purple, paid over time$16.4 millionA $7.0 million note to the sellers, $5.0 million in deferred payments from the closing, of which $2.4 million has been paid since quarter-end, and an earnout recorded at a provisional fair value of $4.4 million, up to a maximum of $8.0 million if all earnout milestones are met. It is owed only if the business reaches its gross profit targets per the acquisition agreement.

Notes are shown at face value. The balance sheet carries the senior convertible notes at $3.2 million and the $11.0 million of convertible notes at $8.5 million, net of unamortized discounts, and the difference is recognized as non-cash interest expense over the life of the notes. The earnout is at the provisional fair value recorded in the Form 10-Q.

The $11.0 million of junior secured convertible notes were structured so that they can become preferred stock at the time of a listing, instead of being repaid in cash, and holders of the senior convertible notes may elect to convert to preferred stock on the same terms at the listing, so up to about $15 million of this can potentially become equity. The purchase price in the table is the part of the price for Advertise Purple that we agreed to pay over time. The cash we paid at closing, about $7.6 million, was funded largely with the proceeds of the senior and junior notes above. That is short-term funding: the junior notes convert to equity on a listing, and the senior notes can convert or be refinanced. The earnout is owed only if Advertise Purple reaches certain contractual milestones, and we intend to pay the seller note and the deferred payments from the cash the combined business generates.

None of that makes the debt go away. We ended the quarter with a working capital deficit of about $15.2 million, our filings continue to say there is substantial doubt about our ability to continue as a going concern, and a listing is not assured. If our listing does not happen, the $11.0 million of convertible notes will remain outstanding and mature in March 2028.

The companies are already working together

JUICE now runs Advertise Purple’s marketing and is bringing it new business, and Advertise Purple’s sales team sends leads to JUICE every month. We are bringing our technology, ONAR AI and Cortex, to Advertise Purple’s teams and clients. Advertise Purple continues to be led by its core team, five of whom signed employment agreements with us at the acquisition.

What comes next

We are pursuing a listing of our common stock on the Nasdaq Capital Market and are in the application and preparation stage. Approval is not assured. A listing requires a higher share price than ours, so a 1-for-250 reverse stock split was approved in October by our board of directors and by the required stockholder vote. The split is not yet effective. It changes the number of shares you hold, not your percentage of the company, and the $0.038576 conversion price of the Series 1 preferred stock adjusts by the same ratio.

The milestones to watch from here are the reverse split taking effect, Nasdaq’s decision on our application, and a senior credit facility to refinance the senior notes, none of which is assured, and then our annual report, the first that will include a full quarter of Advertise Purple.

A year ago, our third quarter revenue was $0.66 million. Counting Advertise Purple for the full quarter, on a pro forma basis this year’s third quarter revenue would have been $4.4 million. The first full quarter together with Advertise Purple is under way.

Thank you for staying with us.

Sincerely,

Claude Zdanow
Chief Executive Officer
ONAR Holding Corporation ( ONAR )

For complete financial statements, related notes and risk factors, including a discussion of the Company’s working capital deficit and going concern considerations, please refer to the Company’s Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, filed with the SEC on November 19, 2026 and available at www.sec.gov.

ONAR ( ONAR ) , pronounced “honor,” is an AI-powered marketing platform. ONAR ( ONAR ) acquires specialist marketing companies serving middle-market and growth-stage brands across performance marketing, creative, and commerce, and operates them as one company on shared proprietary technology designed to automate up to 70% of manual marketing work. Its technology division, ONAR Labs, develops and houses the Company’s proprietary technology, including ONAR AI, a marketing intelligence platform deployed across the Company’s operating companies to improve productivity; Retina AI, a predictive customer intelligence platform; and Cortex, an offline and online sales attribution platform. ONAR ( ONAR ) continues to expand the platform through disciplined acquisitions, including JUICE, Scale Partner, and Advertise Purple. Learn more at www.onar.com.

No Offer or Solicitation

This letter is for informational purposes only and shall not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy any securities. The securities described above were offered and sold in a private placement to accredited investors, have not been registered under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or any state securities laws, and may not be offered or sold in the United States absent registration or an applicable exemption from registration requirements.

data.title: Walmart raises forecasts ahead of holidays, warns of rising fuel costs
data.description:
Nov 19 (Reuters) - Walmart ( WMT ) slightly raised its annual sales and profit forecasts on Thursday, betting that demand for lower-priced groceries and growth in delivery and membership services will bolster business through the crucial holiday shopping season.

But the retail bellwether warned that surging diesel and transportation costs were beginning to work their way into the cost of goods, potentially complicating its efforts to keep prices low for inflation-weary shoppers.

"We want to hold prices as low as we can, as long as we can," CEO John Furner, who took the helm earlier this year, told CNBC on Thursday. "But the reality is, as that increases in diesel fuel and transportation, they do work their way into cost of goods."

Walmart ( WMT ) has cut prices on thousands of grocery and general merchandise items this year as Americans seek cheaper options, but freight and logistics costs have surged following the US war on Iran, squeezing profits across the consumer goods and retail industries.

Walmart ( WMT ) now expects fiscal 2027 net sales to grow 4.9% to 5.2%, up from its previous forecast of 4% to 5%, but below analysts' expectations for 5.5% growth, according to data compiled by LSEG.

The company also raised its annual adjusted earnings forecast to $2.84 to $2.89 per share from $2.80 to $2.87 previously. Analysts expect $2.88 per share.

Operating expenses rose 5% to $40.01 billion in the quarter, while total revenue increased a better-than-expected 5.2% to $188.84 billion. Adjusted earnings of 65 cents per share edged past estimates.

Walmart ( WMT ) shares fell about 1% in premarket trading. The Dow component has gained about 14% this year and is on track for a fourth straight annual gain.

MEMBERSHIPS, E-COMMERCE SUPPORT SALES

Walmart ( WMT ) has pushed deeper into membership, e-commerce and marketplace businesses to diversify revenue and support margins as inflation-weary consumers become increasingly selective about purchases, from pantry staples to apparel.

The retailer launched a cheaper bundled Walmart+ and Sam's Club Plus membership in October ahead of the holiday shopping season. Membership fee revenue rose by double digits in the three months through October.

Its push into faster delivery has also helped drive repeat purchases, while customers using the service were more likely to sign up for its membership program, the company said in August.

For the third quarter, US comparable sales excluding fuel rose 2.9%, in line with estimates, while US e-commerce sales increased 23%, compared with 28% growth a year earlier.

"Growth for the nation's largest store retailer is coming almost entirely from online sales, and the changes in how its higher-spending customers shop mean that Walmart's ( WMT ) vast network of stores is increasingly serving the role of e-commerce fulfillment," Emarketer principal analyst Sky Canaves said.

Rival Target reported another strong quarter on Wednesday and raised its annual forecast as investments in merchandise under new CEO Michael Fiddelke began to pay off.

(Reporting by Juveria Tabassum in Bengaluru and Nicholas P. Brown in New York; Editing by Anil D'Silva)

data.title: US weekly jobless claims increase slightly
data.description:
WASHINGTON, Nov 19 (Reuters) - The number of Americans filing new claims for unemployment benefits increased slightly last week, consistent with a stable labor market, though some laid-off workers are struggling to find new opportunities.

Initial claims for state unemployment benefits rose 1,000 to a seasonally adjusted 203,000 for the week ended November 14, the Labor Department said on Thursday. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast 197,000 claims for the latest week.

Claims had hovered at or below 200,000 since mid-September.

The unemployment rate has dropped from 4.5% in November 2025 to 4.1% in October this year, a development that has been noted by economists and policymakers.

Minutes of the Federal Reserve's October 27-28 policy meeting published on Wednesday showed "many pointed to signs of modest tightening in the labor market." The minutes also noted that policymakers "generally expected labor market conditions to remain stable in the near term and viewed upside and downside risks to the labor market as broadly balanced."

The stable labor market allows the US central bank to focus on stamping out inflation, which is being fueled by the ongoing US-Israeli war with Iran. 

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Wednesday the central bank needs to get more aggressive ‌in its response to inflation that he fears is changing public psychology about prices, and either approve a half-point hike at the December meeting or communicate a faster pace of hikes in 2027. 

The Fed left its benchmark overnight interest rate in the 3.75%-4.00% range last month. The claims report covered the period during which the government surveyed businesses for the nonfarm payrolls component for November's employment report.

Nonfarm payrolls increased by 165,000 jobs in October.

The claims report showed the number of people receiving unemployment benefits after an initial week of aid, a proxy for hiring, increased 70,000 to a seasonally adjusted 1.763 million during the week ended November 7. The jump in the so-called continuing claims suggested that some people who have lost their jobs were experiencing long bouts of unemployment.

(Reporting by Lucia Mutikani; Editing by Chizu Nomiyama)

data.title: GLOBAL MARKETS-Stocks look to blockbuster Anthropic IPO to break losing streak
data.description:
(Updates ahead of Wall Street open)

* Anthropic's blockbuster IPO pricing lifts Nasdaq futures

* Investor worries over AI trade linger

* Hawkish Fed lifts dollar to 19-month high, nudges up bond yields

By Marc Jones

LONDON, Nov 19 (Reuters) - World stocks were in danger of setting their longest losing streak of the year on Thursday as bruised bulls pinned their hopes on Anthropic's blockbuster market debut to lift the otherwise fragile mood.

Asian markets hadn't read the script as Taiwan and Hong Kong both fell heavily overnight, but Europe's tech stocks rallied more than 1% after five straight days of falls while US futures were pointing to a 2% jump for the Nasdaq when it opens shortly.

Elsewhere, gold remained stuck near a 14-month low and benchmark government bond yields ticked up following talk of at least a further 50 basis points' worth of US rate rises. But for the time being it was mostly background noise.

Claude developer Anthropic's IPO is set to be the largest flotation of all time. Its shares were priced at $83 apiece, valuing the firm at about $1.5 trillion.

"At $83 per share, Anthropic is coming to market above its initial pricing range, but still below our $92 fair value estimate," said Malik Ahmed Khan, a senior equity analyst at Morningstar.

Khan said Anthropic would need to sustain rapid growth while managing the enormous cost of developing and running its models.

It is the first major AI developer to go public, so how it trades in the coming days and weeks will be heavily scrutinised to gauge the broader sentiment towards AI following the recent selloffs in some parts of the market.

"The key question (for investors) is whether they are comfortable with that range of outcomes and have a sufficiently long-term horizon," Khan said, referring to how the stock trades.

OIL EDGES UP

In commodities, oil prices began to edge higher again as renewed attacks in the Strait of Hormuz offset a growing view that the oil market will soon be back in surplus. Brent crude futures were just above $92 a barrel, set for a third weekly fall.

Investors were also focusing on an unprecedented three-way meeting held between US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in China.

The three leaders reaffirmed that a nuclear war should never be fought, but in a nod to this year's surge in oil prices, also vowed to increase supplies of refined petroleum products for all countries.

It left the dollar treading water after reaching a 19-month high this week. Hawkish comments from US Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller on Wednesday had bolstered expectations of another US rate hike in December.

The euro was at $1.0990, hovering near its lowest since April 2025. The Japanese yen was at 159.95 per dollar and sterling fetched $1.3145.

Waller had said on CNBC that, if the Fed wanted to get inflation down, it needed to take more "aggressive action", either through a half-point increase at the December meeting or by using the post-meeting statement to set market expectations for further hikes at the start of next year.

The comments followed hotter-than-expected inflation data last week, which caused markets to brace for more rate hikes. Traders now price a 90% chance of a 25-basis-point hike next month, the CME FedWatch tool showed.

The 10-year Treasury yield ticked up to just shy of 5.1% in European trading, dragging both German bund and UK gilt yields up fractionally too.

BERLIN'S BLESSING FOR UNICREDIT

As well as the excitement around Anthropic, Europe's traders also lifted both UniCredit and Commerzbank's shares as Berlin gave its blessing to the takeover of the German bank after years of resistance.

Back to the day's headline act though, and investor confidence in AI has been shaken over the past few weeks by worries about the profitability of the technology and the massive debt needed to fund and build related infrastructure.

Markets have all but shrugged off a strong forecast from chipmaker Nvidia ( NVDA ) this week after Jensen Huang's departure as CEO last week rattled investors. The company's board has now dismissed the idea of rehiring Huang.

Armina Rosenberg, portfolio manager and co-founder of Minotaur Capital, said the Anthropic IPO was a useful gauge of investor appetite for AI.

"But one listing won't settle the debate," she said. "There's a genuine wall of worry right now, and it'll take a few things to climb it."

(Reporting by Marc Jones; Editing by Kevin Liffey and Hugh Lawson)

data.title: US STOCKS-Wall St set for higher open on AI optimism ahead of Anthropic's market debut
data.description:
* Futures up: Dow 0.6%, S&P 500 1.16%, Nasdaq 2.04%

* Anthropic IPO pricing lifts AI-linked stocks

* Cybersecurity firms up after Palo Alto Networks ( PANW ) lifts FY27 forecast

(Updates before markets open, adds analyst comments)

By Medha Singh, Utkarsh Hathi and Ragini Mathur

Nov 19 (Reuters) - Wall Street's main stock indexes were on track to open higher afterAnthropic priced its IPO above the marketed range, fueling expectations for a strong market debut and lifting sentiment toward AI-linked stocks after a brutal rout.

Anthropic priced its upsized offering at $83 per share, above its $70 to $78 range, raising $81 billion in the largest listing on record and valuing the AI lab at about $1.5 trillion. It will begin trading on the Nasdaq later in the day.

The listing follows weeks of selling in chipmakers and cloud companies, as investors fretted over stretched valuations, hefty spending on AI infrastructure and the fallout from Nvidia ( NVDA ) CEO Jensen Huang's abrupt exit.

"A strong debut is the tonic that the market needs after such a volatile period ... We can't underestimate the importance of this IPO. It sort of serves as a valuation for the wider AI ecosystem," said Fiona Cincotta, senior market analyst at StoneX.

Hyperscalers Amazon and Alphabet, both investors in the AI startup, added 2.6% and 4.2%, respectively, in premarket trading.

Chipmakers also gained, with Nvidia ( NVDA ) up 1.6% after falling for five straight sessions through Wednesday, when an upbeat revenue forecast did little to lift sentiment.

Intel ( INTC ), Advanced Micro Devices ( AMD ), Micron and Marvell ( MRVL ) rose between 2.4% and 5%.

Neoclouds CoreWeave and Nebius gained 6% and 7%, respectively, while data center-related companies IREN ( IREN ) and Applied Digital ( APLD ) climbed about 6% each.

Still, caution lingered beneath the enthusiasm, with some investors looking beyond Anthropic's market debut to its ability to generate durable revenue growth.

"After a few quarters, as the company reports results, we will know ... because it's the only way to see the adoption of AI, and that's the key to everything," said Massimo Santicchia, head of US equities at Procyon.

At 8:19 a.m. ET, Dow E-minis were up 300 points, or 0.6%, and S&P 500 E-minis were up 85.5 points, or 1.16%. Nasdaq 100 E-minis were up 555.25 points, or 2.04%.

The S&P 500 fell for a fifth straight session on Wednesday, with hawkish minutes from the US Federal Reserve's latest meeting also weighing on sentiment.

Nearly all Fed officials saw a need for more rate increases if the economy performed as projected, according to the minutes from the central bank's October policy meeting, while a few warned that inflation could be stickier than anticipated and require tighter policy.

Investors will now parse remarks from several Fed officials due later on Thursday.

Traders are pricing in a near-certainty of a 25-basis-point hike at the Fed's December meeting and about an 8% chance of a 50-basis-point move, according to LSEG data.

Among other movers, Palo Alto Networks ( PANW ) shares jumped 9.7% after the cybersecurity firm raised its 2027 revenue forecast, helping drive gains of 4% to 6% in peers CrowdStrike ( CRWD ) , Cloudflare ( NET ), Okta ( OKTA ) and Zscaler ( ZS ).

Walmart ( WMT ) was down 1% even as the retail giant slightly raised its annual targets.

data.title: J.P. Morgan sees Fed rate hikes at next three meetings as inflation persists
data.description:
Nov 19 (Reuters) - J.P. Morgan on Thursday said it expects the US Federal Reserve to deliver quarter-point rate hikes in January and March next year, on top of a previously forecast December increase, as sticky inflation keeps the need for further tightening in play.

"These hikes aren't to deliver a bad labor market, but to preserve credibility when they have no compelling narrative for a pause," said J.P. Morgan strategists led by Michael Feroli.

-- Fed Chair Kevin Warsh has left the monetary policy path without an "overarching narrative," the brokerage said

-- "Without a narrative as a pole star, policy is more likely to be reactive to incoming data," it said

-- In a bid to control inflation, "almost all" policymakers agreed further rate hikes would be needed if the economy evolved as they expected, Fed meeting minutes showed on Wednesday

-- "The labor market has not been a source of inflationary pressure, and yet inflation remains elevated," J.P. Morgan said, adding it expects modest, positive job growth next year

-- Markets see a near-certain 25-basis-point increase in December and an 8% chance of a half-percentage-point move, according to the CME FedWatch tool

-- Brokerages BofA Global Research and Deutsche Bank also expect the central bank to hike rates at each of its next three meetings
